name: scene_flip_page_3af7
notes: boundary helper (page select + show); see scene_render

name: sim_timer_isr
notes: int 8 handler installed by 0x4792; chains old vector (0x6A1F sound ISR) then runs sim every 8th tick

name: sim_input_charkey
notes: 'd'/'D' toggles DS:08BE; 'o'/'O' toggles gate-shift mode DS:0921

name: sim_tick
notes: 12.5 Hz simulation tick body: input, shifting, steering, engine, motion, traffic, police

name: sim_input_direction
notes: fire+direction shifting (gate graph or keyboard gear delta) / steer+throttle

name: sim_shift_knob_anim
notes: gear knob animation, 6 px per tick, completes the shift

name: sim_engine
notes: idle decay, skid decel, brake, free-rev, torque/drag acceleration

name: sim_update_rpm
notes: rpm = ratio*speed>>16, idle floor 800, over-rev => crash state

name: sim_motion
notes: road advance: sub-unit counter, grip/skid, lateral drift, road edge, speed-limit signs

name: sim_advance_unit
notes: one road unit advance (loops while sub-unit < 0)

name: sim_lookahead
notes: reads road byte 40 units ahead: 0xFF => stage end, object => 0x467D

name: sim_traffic_update
notes: grind timer; oncoming list, same-direction list, cop FSM, removal, radar trap, hazard expiry

name: sim_cop_fsm
notes: police car state machine dispatch via DS:0A36

name: sim_object_cleanup
notes: traffic removal, radar trap trigger/chase start, hazard expiry; iret at 0x4673

name: sim_spawn_object
notes: object code dispatch: police trap, oncoming, same-direction traffic, hazards

name: stage_enter_install_isr
notes: stage/cockpit sprite setup, PIT/sound init (0x698C), song 0xB05, hooks int 0 and int 8

name: read_controls
notes: platform: joystick/keyboard -> AX (see simulation.md input section)

name: rng_next
notes: platform range: table RNG, rotates table byte

name: stage_drive_loop
notes: game_flow: per-frame loop, handles DS:0929 exits

name: car_reset_state
notes: game_flow: resets simulation globals (after crash / stage start)

name: sim_snapshot_for_render
notes: scene_render: copies DS:0945..09AC to DS:09AD.. and other state for the frame

name: gearbox_display_toggle
notes: toggled by D key; read by 0x351A (guess: shifter overlay)

name: grind_timer
notes: ticks of shift-clash/clutch-dump effect (3 or 0x12); sets DS:64FE

name: road_pos
notes: player road position = DS address into road stream

name: yaw_lateral
notes: heading used for lateral motion, clamped +-0x4B00

name: view_heading
notes: heading for road renderer (includes skid drift)

name: car_x
notes: lateral position; + = left/oncoming lane; edges +0x264/-0x236; start -0x75

name: cur_ratio
notes: gear ratio of current gear (stale in neutral)

name: rpm_smooth
notes: rpm slewed 0x40 per PIT tick; selects engine note DS:64FC

name: accel_mag
notes: |speed change| of last tick (brake 0x304, skid 0x30) - feeds grip load

name: run_state
notes: 0 driving,1 quit,2 stage end approach,3 crash

name: pit_tick_count
notes: 100 Hz tick counter; sim runs when low 3 bits = 0

name: clock_running
notes: set when first shift completes; cleared on crash

name: oncoming_list
notes: {u16 pos,u16 sub,u16 unused,u16 type*40}; head = newest

name: spill_slot
notes: unused 11th slot (receives data from removal bug)

name: hazard
notes: +0 pos, +6 low byte type<<4, high byte lane 0..3; visual only

name: snapshot_radar_trap_pos
notes: frame copy of DS:099D; drives radar detector lights (0x35C6)

name: cop_state
notes: 0 none,1 chase,2 pass traffic,3 pass player,4/5 lead+brake,6 stopped (ticket),7 trap armed

name: cop_tail_timer
notes: ticks cop tails player before passing (0x78)

name: cop_block_idx
notes: count of same-dir cars ahead of cop; blocker = samedir[idx-1]

name: shift_latch
notes: prevents repeat keyboard shift while held

name: unit_advanced
notes: 1 if road unit advanced this tick (not read)

name: road_anim_counter
notes: incremented per unit advance; read by renderer

name: cop_light_timer
notes: set to 10 on chase start; renderer

name: isr_busy
notes: platform: ISR skips sim while set (pause, calibration)

name: engine_tone_div
notes: note 0x55 divisor slot (DS:6452+0xAA); engine note in song 0xB05

name: cars_left
notes: lives; set 1 when player hits cop

name: clock_ticks
notes: elapsed time in sim ticks (12.5 Hz)

name: car_knob_xy
notes: car +020; (node+7) indexes gate node xy at +03C
